faq.metaDescription: Frequently asked questions about Nemow Al Toseil services, shipping, and more.
faq.pageDescription: Find answers to common questions about our logistics services.
faq.q1Content: We provide land delivery services across all cities and regions in Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Makkah, Madinah, and hundreds more.
faq.q2Title: How can I track my shipment?
faq.q2Content: Enter your tracking number on our Tracking page to get real-time updates on your package location, status, and estimated delivery time.
faq.q3Title: What is the estimated delivery time?
faq.q3Content: Delivery times vary by distance. We offer same-day delivery within major metros and 1-3 day delivery across the Kingdom. For bulky shipments, allow 3-5 business days.
faq.q4Title: How do I get a shipping quote?
faq.q4Content: Contact our sales team at sales@nemow.net or fill out the quote form on our Contact page. We'll respond within 24 hours with a custom quote.
faq.q5Content: Yes, every shipment is fully insured with complete cargo protection. Additional insurance options are available for high-value items.
faq.q6Title: Can I schedule a delivery time?
faq.q6Content: Yes, we offer flexible scheduling options including specific delivery windows. You can coordinate with your dedicated account manager for precise timing.
faq.q7Title: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.q7Content: We accept bank transfers and corporate billing. Contact our sales team for specific payment arrangements.

privacy.section1Content: This privacy policy explains how 'نمو اللوجستية' uses the personal data we collect from you when you use our website. We collect the following data:
privacy.item1Content: Information such as name, email address, and phone number to contact you when you use our services.
privacy.item2Content: To understand your delivery preferences, order history, payment preferences, and other data on نمو اللوجستية.
privacy.item3Content: Information such as location address, shipping documents, and other data to help receive and deliver your shipments.
privacy.item4Content: Information such as your name, email, contact number, etc. shared when filling a form to send an inquiry, submit a complaint, or participate in a user feedback survey, etc.
